next: Ignore one leading Unicode BOM before splitting labels.
constraints: Preserve case, order and duplicate labels.
Keep returning an array, use no dependencies.

initial: module.exports = function defaults(value) { return value === undefined ? 'default' : value; };
goal: Apply a default to a missing configuration value.
constraints: Preserve false, numeric zero and the empty string.
Use no dependencies.
rejected: Do not replace the explicit check with value || 'default'.

initial: module.exports = function strip(s) { return s.endsWith('.tmp') ? s.slice(0,-4) : s; };
goal: Strip one temporary-file suffix while preserving the identifier.
constraints: Remove only one final suffix.
Preserve the case and Unicode of the preceding identifier.
rejected: Do not lowercase the entire filename or replace internal suffixes.

goal: Display externally assigned IDs as strings.
next: Trim surrounding whitespace in string IDs.
constraints: Keep leading zeroes and duplicate IDs in original order.
Do not mutate the input array.
rejected: Do not parse IDs with Number or parseInt.

initial: module.exports = function flag(s) { if (s === 'true') return true; if (s === 'false') return false; return null; };
goal: Parse an explicit text flag with an unknown result.
next: Accept surrounding whitespace and case variations of true and false.
constraints: Return null for every unrecognized value, including an empty string, yes and 1.
Keep Boolean results for recognized values.
rejected: Do not use Boolean(value) or accept arbitrary truthy strings.

initial: module.exports = function first(rows) { const seen=new Set(); return rows.filter(x=>{if(seen.has(x.id)) return false; seen.add(x.id); return true;}); };
goal: Keep the first record for each exact ID.
next: Ignore rows whose id is null or undefined.
constraints: IDs are case sensitive; 0 and empty-string IDs remain valid.
Keep original order and the first record, without mutating input.
rejected: Do not sort records or collapse IDs through string conversion.

goal: Produce a safe copy of a settings object for display.

constraints: Preserve all other enumerable values, including false and null.

rejected: Do not delete secret properties from the original object.

goal: Split text into lines without altering content.

constraints: Keep empty lines, including the trailing empty line.

rejected: Do not filter empty strings or split on every whitespace character.

initial: module.exports = function header(rows) { const row=rows.find(x=>x.name === 'X-Trace'); return row ? row.value : null; };

next: Match the header name case insensitively.
constraints: Return the first match, retaining exact value and empty strings.
Do not mutate rows or normalize returned values.
rejected: Do not use a truthy fallback or take the last duplicate.

initial: module.exports = function unprefix(s) { return s.startsWith('ref:') ? s.slice(4) : s; };
goal: Remove an optional reference prefix from an opaque identifier.

constraints: Remove only one prefix at position zero.
